verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the local-first claim that 'your code never leaves your machine unless you say so.' That implies Superset itself does not collect code that could be used for training, but it says nothing explicit about AI training. Code still flows to the third-party agents it orchestrates (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), whose training policies are not covered. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out control, coverage of data sent through the orchestrated agents or synced and remote features, and independent corroboration.
